note: c038 (Waymark, 2026-10-26; brief 067): the Handover route set re-composed once on the final engine 0.34.1 (cb1604f6, GDD v0.26.0), with briefs 059 and 067 in. Engine: the cell walks 1.8 and runs 3.6 m/s, a run is noticed never an Alert (route A ends at Alert 0), the patrol sweeps the service yard, the held car (hiding in a held car loses, the cell down fails, Go needs a standing driver), SQ1/SQ2 on the bare square, posts beside doors, an advance closes. Routes: plain A and G take no Reroute; route B and twins reroute at 5:00 and keep the Enforcer at the square to 5:50 (no loiter report: MC-12 14/14); route-a and route-a-disable hold Vale at (20.0, -65.0); route B locks staggered 0.5 s; route-a-pressure and its twin send the Enforcer to the door from 2:40 so Vale meets the posted crew (16/16 jitters, was 3/8), the board twin walking Vale in at blocker.out; route-g-kill strikes once the loop has landed (16/16, was 14/16); the loud family breaks the drawn crew first (loud-x4, S11 shape), loud-fight with the carbine. Brief 059: route-b-block(-board) and loud-fast retired; route-b-thin, careless-thin-all, fight-safe-cell-down (the cell down), one loud-wait twin per stand. Checker: MC-3 needs (fail-entry-seen-patrol pending: patrolWatchesEntry false), MC-11 every stand plus no hold that did not come for the car, MC-13, MC-14, MC-15 new. Every reference route wins 16/16 on per-operative jitter; every other script keeps its outcome 8/8.
